decisions.reason: Removing the copyright-page publication-attribution line does not change the cover visual, image count, or trim size.
The decision concerns a copyright-page line and does not affect Chapter 18 heading typography.
Removing the attribution line has no effect on chapter-image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
The removed line is independently represented by the copyright-attribution Requirement; none of this candidate's current manuscript-integrity attributes becomes stale.
The source removes one copyright-page attribution line but does not remove or alter the required back matter or author lines.
The copyright-line removal does not change the requested KDP guidance workflow or listing-material assistance.
The book remains a 6-by-9-inch paperback regardless of removal of the publication-attribution line.
Removing one copyright-page line does not change the selected alignment of the remaining copyright-page content.
The copyright attribution decision does not change the deferred paragraph-spacing and body-density requirement.
The removal of copyright-page text does not affect chapter illustration coverage, placement, or presentation.
The source decision does not change the requirement to update table-of-contents page numbers after fixing the book size.
Removing the copyright-page attribution line does not alter the justified alignment selected for body text.
